title: ARC Control Audit Record
description: The audit log is append-only and hash-chained: every record carries the digest of its predecessor, so editing a record breaks the link every later record depends on, and removing one leaves a sequence gap. Verification needs nothing but the records themselves.

sequence.description: Monotonic position in the chain, starting at 1. A gap is a removed record.

actor.description: Who or what caused the event: an agent id, a human identifier, or "system".

summary.description: One line a human can read without decoding the data field.

previousDigest.description: Digest of the previous record, or sha256:0*64 for the first.

digest.description: Digest over this record's content including previousDigest.
